incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD alert: dedicated-pool-3 p99 latency > 10s for 3 mins (autoscaler lag suspected). PagerDuty: S1. Hits: multiple customers. /cc @maria (oncall)

maria (oncall): seeing it, joining. any customer-facing errors showing?

lia (support): several customers reported streaming timeouts, chat clients show stalls and then `502` once the queue backs up. ticket IDs: #C1234, #C1235.

maria (oncall): grabbing metrics — p95 ~ 1.4s but p99 jumping to 12s. queue_depth for pool3 at 980 (capacity 1024), warmup backlog spiking.

ajay (runtime): looks like autoscaler requested nodes but handshake/warmup failing due to slow container init on new backends, heartbeats delayed. logs show warmup image pull + model load ~ 90s in some AZs.

sam (sre): running quick query: `curl -s https://metrics.internal/api?m=queue_depth,p95,p99&pool=pool3&range=5m`

ajay (runtime): paste of relevant log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T18:21:03Z] pool3: slot-provision request -> instance-launch (i-0abcde)
[2026-03-15T18:21:35Z] instance i-0abcde: pull image failed: registry timeout
[2026-03-15T18:22:12Z] instance i-0abcde: image pulled, starting model load
[2026-03-15T18:23:50Z] model load complete, but KV cache priming stalled for 35s
```

maria (oncall): so autoscaler issued capacity, but warmup jitter (image pulls + model load variance) means capacity isn't usable fast enough -> queue growth -> tail latency.

lia (support): which customers impacted? any enterprise SLA hits?

maria (oncall): early list from tracing: customer-a (high qps chat), customer-b (batch inference), a handful of free-tier apps. Marking customer-a as impacted and escalating to AE.

sam (sre): short-term mitigations: 1) shift routing for customer-a to pool2 (has spare headroom) 2) manual warmup on recently launched instances (run priming script) 3) increase per-pool pre-warmed slots if we have spare reserved capacity.

ajay (runtime): I'm running a manual priming job on i-0abcde: `ssh ... && /opt/redwood/bin/prime-kv-cache --model gptx-4-ld` — priming should remove KV coldpath stalls. ETA ~ 40s.

maria (oncall): doing routing rollback: `routes set --from pool3 --to pool2 --filter customer=customer-a` — applying now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot reports: route change applied in 3s.

lia (support): customer-a confirmed decreased stalls (via their console). telling AE.

sam (sre): also flipping autoscaler policy on pool3 to aggressive warmup (reduce max_concurrent_image_pulls=2 -> 4? wait that's the opposite) — set `max_concurrent_image_pulls=1` to reduce registry contention, and `preload_parallel=2` to allow model load overlapping. applying change.

ajay (runtime): note: registry had transient 503 in us-east-1 at 18:20-18:26. making a note to use cached images in future.

maria (oncall): p99 trending down to 3.2s from 12s. queue_depth steady at ~120. Good.

lia (support): customers updated, tickets labeled `incident:dedicated-warmup-jitter`.

ops-rotation: Maria, do you want to handoff or keep owning? next rotation in 45m.

maria (oncall): I'll stay until stable values for 30m post-mitigation. sam, ajay please prepare brief RCA notes — likely root cause: autoscale launched instances + image pull/regional registry jitter + KV priming variance -> effective capacity lag.

sam (sre): recording runbook actions: `1) reroute impacted customers, 2) manual priming of launched instances, 3) tweak autoscaler warmup params, 4) increase pre-warm slots for peak windows, 5) follow-up: move to image-cache on local AMIs or GCR mirror`

ajay (runtime): I'll open a follow-up tracking ticket to implement AMI baked images with models for hot models and to add explicit registry retry/backoff for image pulls.

maria (oncall): capture SLO impact: 3m breach at p99 > 10s, impacted ~6 customers with elevated tail latency. We'll include token-level cost check in postmortem.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation observed: p99 < 5s and queue_depth < 200 for 10 minutes. Monitoring will keep this thread open for 30m.

lia (support): closing customer-facing ops note after 20m once stable.

ops-rotation: thanks team. Maria — handoff decision?

maria (oncall): oncall continues until 19:20Z (30m stable). ops-rotation, take if I don't post stable update by then.

sam (sre): adding log pointers and a perf graph link: https://grafana.internal/d/pool3/warmup-jitter-2026

ajay (runtime): opened issue INF-4821 for AMI baking + INF-4822 for registry retry/backoff.

maria (oncall): final note for thread: immediate customer-visible impact mitigated via routing + priming. Root cause hypothesis: warmup jitter amplified by registry slowness. Postmortem owners: ajay + sam. Lia will coordinate customer comms.

ops-rotation: acknowledged. I'll pick up if still unstable at 19:20Z. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: thread automatically closed for paging but will remain in Slack for manual closure.
